WaitForCatchUp=false has no outer catch-up bound and the new finally drains both tasks. An indefinitely noncooperative Organization source could delay an already selected Folder failure; the supported lane uses bounded Dapr sources and the500ms enabled catch-up wrapper. A concrete supported noncooperative source/caller reproduction and its ownership/lease contract are needed before changing drain semantics or inventing another timeout.

The reviewer reproduced shutdown blocking on an idle non-TLS peer. Baseline47a1ffd already uses HTTPServer, wraps the listening socket for TLS and calls server.shutdown identically. This lifecycle defect is pre-existing; record it separately without changing this story's runtime protocol.

projects_process_identity and restart validation rebind processes/binaries but do not rerun the existing finite process-environment option census. Record and verify the restarted Projects options against the initial mode; use the existing read-only helper.

Observe/ObservePair explicitly suppress ExecutionContext flow when attaching a continuation. ExecuteSynchronously is not a guarantee of running in the original request context; queued completion can emit resource hashes/Exists/sequences without the privacy scope. Capture protection before detaching and omit identifying diagnostics for protected reads; retain ordinary diagnostics.
